hook: I want every employee to understand their pay, in any country

builtFor.context: Remote pays people in many countries, each with its own taxes, contributions and payslip format. Pay is the most personal thing Remote touches. When a payslip looks different and the employee can't tell why, trust drops, for them and for the employer who chose Remote.

opportunities.title: Explain changes, not just totals
opportunities.body: Lead each payslip with what changed since last month and why, in plain language, so employees don't decode a PDF.

opportunities.title: Share logic across both sides
opportunities.body: Employers now get Variance and Gross-to-Net reports. A simplified employee view can reuse the same logic, so both sides see the same story.

opportunities.title: Precise questions, faster answers
opportunities.body: Let employees ask about one specific line with the payslip context attached, so support starts from the right place.

body: My background is FinTech, lending and RegTech: products where people make decisions about money and need to trust what they see.

At Shecluded I designed interfaces that presented lending data and account activity clearly for first-time borrowers. At Foodlify I designed a wallet-first checkout and a design system used across four product lines.

bring.title: Financial clarity
bring.body: Turning complex financial and compliance data into screens people can act on.

bring.title: Design systems
bring.body: Knowing when to follow a system like Norma, and how to contribute back.

bring.title: AI prototyping
bring.body: Working prototypes in code, like the one in this pitch.

systemsGets: Someone who can design one sensitive moment, like a payslip, while keeping it consistent with Norma and every other surface in the pay ecosystem.

opportunity.title: Why My Pay Changed
opportunity.problem: Remote's pay summary breaks a payslip into totals, but when net pay changes, employees have to work out why. The help center points them to country guides or support. Employers recently got Variance reports; employees haven't.
opportunity.solution: Open each payslip with the change since last month, list only the lines that moved with a plain-language reason, and let the employee ask about one line with context attached.

firstWeek.intro: My first week would focus on how employees experience pay across countries, then contributing one useful improvement with the team.

days.body: Meet the pay team, design, payroll experts and support. Learn priorities, the Norma design system and how success is measured.
Review payslip-related support tickets and research. Tag questions by cause and country.
Agree on one pay moment to improve, grounded in evidence and what the data already supports.
Prototype with real (anonymised) payslip cases and review edge cases with a payroll expert.
Share findings, the prototype, the trade-offs and a proposed next step, asynchronously and live.

ask: I'd love to bring financial-product design experience, systems thinking and fast AI prototyping to Remote's mission of making global employment easy, starting with pay people can trust.
